purpose: Correct only the post-commit validation semantics of the immutable v1 integration receipt. The paired prerequisite integration evidence and authority outcome remain unchanged.

supersedesValidationSemanticsOnly.preservation: Both v1 files remain immutable historical evidence. This successor replaces only their unstable current-HEAD/current-XML validation behavior and incorrect error-count reporting.

correctionReasons.finding: The v1 validator required frontend HEAD and origin/dwp-dev to remain exactly at the earlier admission carrier 3ae4671e. Committing the valid v1 receipt advanced frontend dwp-dev to 6cbf4f1e, so the historical validator rejected its own append-only evidence commit.
The v1 result payload reported errorsCount from the JUnit aggregate instead of len(errors), which could display errorsCount=0 while validator failures were present.
The v1 validator made build-directory JUnit XML a permanent dependency even though those exact bytes are already sealed in the immutable receipt and build outputs may be legitimately cleaned later.

validationSemantics.authoringMode: Before this successor is committed, --authoring permits only these exact two untracked v2 carrier files; all other frontend changes and every backend change fail closed.
validationSemantics.junitXmlRule: The v1 receipt's exact XML byte/hash/count evidence remains authoritative. Any of the nine XML files that still exist are rehashed and parsed; absent cleaned build outputs do not invalidate historical integration evidence.
validationSemantics.errorCountRule: errorsCount and p0 both equal len(errors); they never reuse JUnit error counts.
validationSemantics.descendantSemanticsSelfCheck: The validator proves the earlier admission commit 3ae4671e is an ancestor of receipt commit 6cbf4f1e and uses the same predicate for future current HEAD and origin refs.

nonClaims: The v1 receipt or validator was edited.
A new backend integration or source change occurred.
Runtime, module-owner, full HRM-013, UI, tenant or production work is authorized.
